first: कस्य दोषः कुलेनास्ति व्याधिना के न पीडितः ।
en: Whose family has no fault? Who is never troubled by illness? Who has never met misfortune? Who has lasting happiness without a break?
Conduct shows a person's family, speech shows his homeland, eager welcome shows affection, and the body shows how he eats.
Marry a daughter into a good family, set a son to learning, bring trouble upon an enemy, and guide a friend toward right living.

first: दुर्जनस्य च सर्पस्य वरं सर्पो न दुर्जनः ।
en: Between a wicked man and a snake, the snake is better; a snake bites only now and then, but a wicked man hurts at every step.
That is why kings keep people of good family around them; such people do not leave the king at the beginning, middle or end.
At the end of the world even the oceans are said to break their shores; but good people never break their bounds, even then.
Keep away from a fool, for he is a two-legged beast; his words pierce like a thorn you cannot see.
Even those who have beauty, youth and a great family do not shine without learning, like kinshuk flowers that have no scent.
A cuckoo's beauty is its voice, a woman's beauty is faithfulness to her husband, the beauty of the plain-looking is learning, and the beauty of a holy man is forgiveness.
Give up one person to save the family, give up the family to save the village, give up the village to save the country, and give up the whole world to save your soul.

first: उद्योगे नास्ति दारिद्र्य जपतो नास्ति पातकम् ।
en: Hard work leaves no room for poverty, prayer leaves no room for sin, silence leaves no room for quarrels, and wakefulness leaves no room for fear.
Sita suffered for too much beauty, Ravana for too much pride, and Bali was bound for too much giving; so avoid excess in everything.
What load is too heavy for the strong? What place is too far for the hard-working? What land is foreign to the learned? Who is a stranger to one who speaks kindly?
A whole forest is made fragrant by one good sweet-smelling tree in flower, just as a family is made famous by one good son.
A whole forest burns because of one dry tree on fire, just as a whole family is ruined by one bad son.
One good son who is learned and virtuous brings joy to the whole family, as the moon brightens the night.
What use are many sons who bring only grief and pain? Better is one son who supports the family and in whom the family finds rest.
Pamper a son for five years, discipline him for ten, and once he turns sixteen treat him like a friend.
In a riot, an enemy invasion, a terrible famine, or in the company of bad people, the one who runs away survives.
One who gains none of the four aims of life (duty, wealth, pleasure and freedom) is born again and again only to die.

first: मूर्खा यत्र न पुज्यन्ते धान्यं यत्र सुसञ्चितम् ।
en: Where fools are not honoured, where grain is well stored, and where husband and wife do not quarrel, there wealth and good fortune come on their own.
